li.label: steadied
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} has been through something and come out the other side of it. {PAWN_pronoun} is not untouched — {PAWN_pronoun} is harder to knock over than {PAWN_pronoun} was.\n\nWhen somebody else is struggling, {PAWN_pronoun} is better than most at sitting with them, because {PAWN_pronoun} knows what it is.

li.label: weathered
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} has come through more than most people are asked to, and is still here, and is still {PAWN_objective}self.\n\nVery little rattles {PAWN_objective} now. Not because {PAWN_pronoun} stopped feeling things — {PAWN_pronoun} feels them and carries on. The others go to {PAWN_objective} when it is bad, and {PAWN_pronoun} is the reason some of them are still standing.
